name: Hwang Seonyu
source:
An elegant, handsome man. He's masculine, but his fairy-like appearance wins him the likeability of both men and women. He suddenly reappeared after cutting off contact with Shinju.

He's the developer of "Dream World." His original major is neuroscience.

[From in-game profile]
